name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at the University of Malaya, specializing in aerodynamics. After graduating, he joined a small Malaysian racing team, gaining hands-on experience in vehicle dynamics and data analysis. His talent quickly became apparent, leading to a coveted position at a Formula 2 team in Europe.

He steadily climbed the ranks, proving his worth through innovative solutions and a meticulous approach to problem-solving. He excels at identifying performance bottlenecks and implementing data-driven strategies to optimize vehicle setup. His reputation for pushing the boundaries of engineering and his focus on performance led to the offer from Scuderia Ferrari.

Ahmad believes in fostering a collaborative environment where engineers feel empowered to challenge conventional wisdom. He is known for his unwavering commitment to excellence and his ability to motivate his team to achieve peak performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed hair with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Ahmad is of average height and build, with a focused expression and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific blend of Malaysian coffee in the team garage.
